_comment: Krishna Universe - Hindi Shorts pipeline. Krishna leela + one seekh per reel, 30s vertical, 5/day at India prime time.

video._comment_duration: The composer never trims to max_duration_seconds - it always matches the voiceover. Real control is gemini.target_words below. These bounds only clamp and log.
video._comment_cuts: image_cut_seconds is how long one generated Krishna frame holds; clip_cut_seconds is how long a real atmosphere cutaway holds. Short cutaways between longer story frames is what reads as edited footage rather than a slideshow.

motion._comment: Camera-move engine (video_composer._motion_from_image). Every frame gets a DIFFERENT move: pan/tilt/drift run at constant scale (cheap, no per-frame resample) while push_in/pull_out pay for a resize, so the weights in _MOVE_WEIGHTS keep zooms in the minority. overscan is how much larger than the frame the image is rendered, i.e. how much room the camera has to travel.

ai_images._comment: PRIMARY visual source. There is no stock footage of Krishna anywhere, so each narration beat becomes a generated frame. POLLINATIONS_TOKEN is effectively required here (not optional as on other channels): without it most requests are rate-limited and the reel ends up with no Krishna in it at all.
ai_images.style: cinematic devotional Indian art, richly detailed painterly realism, warm golden hour light, volumetric god rays, deep saturated colours, ornate traditional Indian clothing and jewellery, 85mm lens depth of field, highly detailed faces

gemini._comment: Hindi reads slower than English: the configured voice runs ~130 words/min, so ~65 words is about 30 seconds. A reel under min_words is rejected and the next model is tried.

tts._comment: Hindi katha voice. Small pool on purpose - see the note in modules/tts.py. Rate is slow: katha is narrated, not read out.

fonts._comment: Devanagari font used by modules/textrender.py. DejaVu (the moviepy/ImageMagick default) has NO Devanagari glyphs, so Hindi would render as empty boxes. The workflow installs fonts-noto-devanagari; override with KRISHNA_FONT_PATH if needed.

captions._comment: OFF ON PURPOSE. A rolling word-by-word subtitle track sits right on top of the artwork, and on this channel the artwork IS the video. Mid-video flash phrases (below) give a muted viewer something to read instead. Do not switch this back on without looking at a rendered reel first.

flash_text._comment: Three short Hindi phrases, ~1.3s each, in the UPPER third where the deity's face is not, with no backdrop panel. This is what replaced captions: a muted viewer still gets text, the frame stays clear.

hook._comment: First 2.5s. Text is script.screen_hook (2-4 Hindi words), never the full spoken sentence - a whole sentence at this size is unreadable on a phone.

music._comment: Drop devotional instrumental tracks (flute / sitar / tanpura) into assets/music to override the synth bed. Volume is low: the katha voice must stay in front.

pexels._comment: Atmosphere cutaways ONLY - river water, rain, lamp flame, peacock, cows. Never people: stock footage of people in Indian dress looks like stock and breaks the spell.

seo._comment: Consumed by modules/seo.py. Everything there is per-video and drawn through the no-repeat history; these are only counts and the channel URL.

youtube._comment_hashtags: FALLBACK ONLY. Per-video rotating hashtags come from modules/seo.py.
youtube._comment_tags: FALLBACK ONLY. modules/seo.py packs the per-video tag set into YouTube's 500-char budget.
